primitives.name: Differential Response to Stimuli
primitives.verbatim_quote: The differential response in animals to stimuli varying within a single dimension.
primitives.assumptions: Responses are smooth functions of stimulus intensity along a single continuum, with distinct thresholds for excitation and inhibition.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when responses depend on multidimensional feature spaces or exhibit hysteresis effects.
